question: What will the first reported revenues after September 2026 be for the following companies? (Amazon)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Amazon actual quarterly revenue vs top of its own guidance range over the last eight quarters. It came in between 0.7B below and 3.7B above the top, usually above (Q3'25 +0.7, Q4'25 +0.4, Q1'26 +3.0, Q2'25 +3.7). Q3'26 guide is 197-202B, so the top is 202B. Consensus is ~202.2B (MarketBeat); LSEG's pre-guide figure was 204.1B. AWS accelerated to 37% in Q2, so a beat on the AWS side is plausible. The guide's low end is weighed down by Prime Day moving into June (~400bp headwind). The dollar strengthened ~2% in September, beyond the guide's -80bp FX assumption, which tempers the upside. Median ~203.2B. Market check: no Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi contract found.
calls.dossier:
- Amazon Q3 2026 guidance (8-K ex99.1, 2026-07-30): net sales $197.0B-$202.0B (+9% to +12% y/y vs Q3'25 180.169B); operating income $22.5-26.5B; assumes ~80bp unfavorable FX; excluding Prime Day effects in both years, growth would be ~400bp higher.
- Prime Day 2026 ran June 23-26 (in Q2), while Prime Day 2025 was in July (in Q3). That creates a tough Q3 comparison (CNBC 2026-07-30).
- Q2 2026 actual: 200.606B, FX +0.1B; AWS +37% y/y, its fastest since 2021, vs ~31% expected (CNBC/Investing transcript, 2026-07-30).
- Consensus Q3 revenue ~$202.19B, +12.2% y/y (MarketBeat, Oct 2026). LSEG pre-guide expectation was $204.1B (CNBC 2026-07-30).
- Analysts expect AWS +30-35% y/y in Q3 (Motley Fool 2026-10-16). Deutsche Bank raised its AWS growth forecast (BigGo, Oct 2026).
- FX: DXY rose ~2.0% in September 2026 and closed Q3 ~101.5; EUR/USD fell toward ~1.12-1.14 late in the quarter (Parity Q3 commentary 2026-10-09; ECB ref 1.1403 on 9/25). The dollar was stronger than in July, when the guide was set.
- Historical actual vs top of guidance: Q3'24 +0.4B (158.9 vs 158.5); Q4'24 -0.7B (187.8 vs 188.5); Q1'25 +0.2B (155.7 vs 155.5); Q2'25 +3.7B (167.7 vs 164); Q3'25 +0.7B (180.2 vs 179.5); Q4'25 +0.4B (213.4 vs 213); Q1'26 +3.0B (181.5 vs 178.5); Q2'26 not verified this run. Amazon has landed below the low end of its guidance zero times in this sample.
- Status quo: a report at or slightly above the top of the guidance range.
- Resolves off the Q3 2026 earnings release (8-K) net sales as initially reported, expected Oct 29, 2026 after the close; not segment or restated figures.
- Event window: quarter ended Sept 30, 2026, with the report expected 2026-10-29. As of 2026-10-21 the quarter is fully elapsed and only the reporting remains.
- Searched, not found: any Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold contract on Amazon revenue; Q2'26 guidance range; the exact Q3 average EUR/USD.
